templates.name: Salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ
templates.description: “Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah sends ten upon him.” A daily wird of 100.

templates.name: Istighfar — Seeking Forgiveness
templates.description: The Prophet ﷺ sought Allah's forgiveness more than seventy times a day. A wird of 100.

templates.name: Subhan Allah wa bi-hamdihi
templates.description: “Whoever says it 100 times a day, his sins are wiped away even if like the foam of the sea.” (Muslim)

templates.name: Tahlil — Declaring Allah's Oneness
templates.description: Said 100 times: equals freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds recorded, a hundred sins erased. (Bukhari & Muslim)

templates.name: Two phrases beloved to the Most Merciful
templates.description: “Two phrases light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful.” (Bukhari & Muslim)

templates.name: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
templates.description: “A treasure from the treasures of Paradise.” (Bukhari & Muslim) A daily wird.

templates.name: Daily Qur'an Reading
templates.description: Five pages each day to keep a steady share of the Qur'an.

templates.name: One Juz' a Day
templates.description: About twenty pages daily — a complete Qur'an in a month.

templates.name: Recite Surah al-Mulk
templates.description: A surah that intercedes for its reciter until he is forgiven; read each night.
